column3: Community activity is independently supported after the authors' no-bacteria adjustment, but the 2019 pH controls show substantial abiotic instability; do not call a universal microbiome-specific response.
The isolated-strain screen is negative while many communities are positive; the same chemical identity must not be assigned one global response label.
Independent strain-selective and community activity support a biological positive control; this does not establish an unresolved-signal increment.
